visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing an elaborate red and white Victorian-style gown and matching bonnet, walks gracefully towards the camera along a paved stone walkway. Behind her is a lush green tree and a white, two-story Western-style building with a balcony. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand holding two entrance tickets featuring a colorful image of a cathedral's interior. The tickets indicate a price of 1000 yen and the name Oura Cathedral. The background shows a white door and a blurry informational sign. (3) The woman, now in casual attire consisting of a white button-up shirt and denim skirt with a yellow bag, walks up a long flight of stone stairs. Several other visitors are seen climbing the stairs ahead of her towards a statue at the top. (4) She stands in a courtyard area in front of a large stone relief carving depicting religious figures. She turns and smiles at the camera before walking past the carving. The ground is gravel and there are large trees in the background. (5) The camera tilts up the exterior of Oura Church, a white Gothic-style building with black arched windows and a statue of the Virgin Mary at the entrance. The sky is clear and blue, and stone steps lead up to the church. (6) The woman walks through a charming narrow street with white historical buildings and stone paving. She waves at the camera. In the background, a man in black walks past her. (7) She explores an outdoor corridor with green-painted pillars and white walls. She is seen walking up a small step into an exhibit area. A white chain barrier is visible. (8) She is standing on a long, inclined escalator inside a green-framed structure. The camera is positioned behind her as she moves upward. Large green trees are visible through the openings of the escalator housing. (9) As she moves on the escalator, a visual transition effect occurs, changing her clothes from the casual white shirt to the red Victorian gown. She turns around to face the camera, smiling and gesturing with her hands. (10) She is seen in a garden area with lush bushes and stone paths, wearing the red gown. She twirls around, showing off the layers of her dress. The lighting is bright and warm. (11) Standing on a high balcony with white railings, she looks out over a panoramic view of Nagasaki city and the harbor. She is still in the red gown and bonnet. She smiles and makes a peace sign with her hand. (12) A man in a blue t-shirt and cap kneels in front of her on the balcony, holding her hand in a mock proposal gesture. She laughs and looks at the camera while wearing the elaborate red period dress. (13) She is back in the garden, performing a rhythmic dance movement in the red dress. She smiles broadly at the camera. Another transition then changes her back into her casual white shirt and denim skirt. (14) Inside a restaurant, a close-up shot shows a round hot plate with raw beef slices, broccoli, carrots, and onions. Steam rises from the sizzling meat. A hand pours a dark sauce over the food from a small white pitcher. (15) The woman is seen lifting a cooked piece of beef with chopsticks towards her mouth. She is wearing her casual white shirt. The background is a simple restaurant interior with warm lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 來九州長崎實現公主夢. [Logo]: @HanHan. (2) [Subtitle]: 這裡是長崎的大浦天主堂. (3) [Subtitle]: 以前來過九州，但一直沒機會來長崎. (4) [Subtitle]: 這次想避開人潮，去一個比較冷門的景點. (5) [Subtitle]: 大浦天主堂是日本現存最古老的天主教教室. (6) [Subtitle]: 是仿造哥德式建築的教堂. (7) [Subtitle]: 當時日本還沒有西洋石造技術. (8) [Subtitle]: 主要是靠木造結構，讓外表看起來像哥德式. (9) [Subtitle]: 教堂裡面因為不能拍照. (10) [Subtitle]: 但教堂內部有著美麗的彩繪玻璃窗. (11) [Subtitle]: 大家可能會覺得看教堂有點無趣. (12) [Subtitle]: 但是認真了解歷史之後，才覺得其實很有意思. (13) [Subtitle]: 譬如：400多年前基督徒遭迫害的畫，讓我印象很深刻. (14) [Subtitle]: 雖然我不是基督徒，但它彷彿像一扇窗，讓人感受. (15) [Subtitle]: 過去的人，為了信念所付出的代價. (16) [Subtitle]: 這次的長崎之旅，讓我有一種「獨活女子」的慢步調氛圍. (17) [Subtitle]: 沒有太多的觀光客，可以慢活的在這個城市裡穿梭. (18) [Subtitle]: 這裡除了教堂之外，還有一個很有有趣的活動，就是... (19) [Logo]: レトロ衣裳館. [Variety]: 變裝體驗. (20) [Subtitle]: 上次在京都都體驗和服後，這次看到租借服飾店，又開始皮癢. (21) [Subtitle]: 假掰一下. 大家好我是塔塔公主... (22) [Subtitle]: 歡迎大家一起穿越時空，回到19世紀維多利. (23) [Subtitle]: 今天是我選駙馬爺的大日子 哈哈哈哈... (24) [Subtitle]: 怎感覺我打扮起來像媽媽桑. 之前穿和服也是... (25) [Subtitle]: 選來選去還是這隻青蛙好了... (26) [Subtitle]: 我不管，我要你重新跟我求婚，重來、重來... (27) [Subtitle]: 阿桑我太開心. (28) [Subtitle]: 突然想到電影裡...跳踢踏舞的橋段. (29) [Subtitle]: 結果被持家舅《起童》. (30) [Subtitle]: 兒子說，我根本就是早晨公園裡的那些阿嬤. (31) [Subtitle]: 12點到了，鐘聲響...已經被打回原形. (32) [Subtitle]: 好了，阿桑夢做完了，12點到了，鐘聲響...已經被打回原型. (33) [Subtitle]: 肚子餓了，來吃長崎特有的檸檬牛. (34) [Subtitle]: 淋上醬. (35) [Subtitle]: 鐵板牛排滋滋作響的聲音，肚子咕嚕咕嚕. (36) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉. (37) [Subtitle]: 長崎Vlog故事就說到這...大家下次見！
